settingsHub.title: Settings
settingsHub.subtitle: Context, sources, notifications — and advanced diagnostics if you need them.
settingsHub.actionsDesc: Next steps from your Context — open, tried, or ignored.

settingsHub.sourcesDesc: RSS, Hacker News, GitHub, Reddit, V2EX, Zhihu and more.
settingsHub.systemDesc: Health checks and AI monitor — for self-host diagnostics.
settingsHub.llmNotReady: Not ready — set OPENAI_* in .env (local Ollama or cloud API key)
settingsHub.llmDegraded: The AI model last failed; scoring and summaries are using rules.
settingsHub.aiDegraded: The AI model is failing — scoring and summaries fell back to rules.
settingsHub.aiOn: AI is on: impact, summaries and recommendations come from the LLM; items are tagged AI.
settingsHub.aiOff: AI is not ready: scores are rule-based. Default is local Ollama at localhost:11434 — start Ollama with your model, or set a cloud URL + OPENAI_API_KEY in .env.
settingsHub.stripAiDegraded: Degraded · AI fell back to rules
settingsHub.healthHint: Same signals as ./scripts/status.sh. If translate is down, titles stay English.
settingsHub.healthDownHint: Backend is not responding. Run ./install.sh or check data/ai-radar.log.
settingsHub.healthTranslateDownHint: Argos sidecar is down — titles stay English. See translate-service/README.md or ./install.sh.
settingsHub.healthLlmNotConfiguredHint: No usable LLM detected (no local endpoint and no API key) — scoring and summaries fall back to rules. Configure OPENAI_* in .env.
settingsHub.healthLlmUntestedHint: Configured, but no calls yet — run Update now once to verify it responds.
settingsHub.healthLlmFailedHint: The last model call failed, so scoring and summaries have fallen back to rules.
settingsHub.healthScheduleHint: Schedule changes apply immediately after save — no restart needed.
settingsHub.howItWorksBody: Each item's score stacks two layers: (1) rules — interest-keyword hits, source weight (GitHub/HN boosted), and heat (log stars/points); (2) AI — once an LLM is ready, impact analysis runs on changes.
